source_pr_title: Fix literal $HOME in AGENT_CONFIG_DIR + install claude CLI
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Security Vulnerability**: Using `eval echo` on user-controllable configuration (`cfg.dir`) enables command injection attacks[^1]. An attacker could set `dx.core.agentConfig.dir` to include malicious shell commands that would be executed during shell initialization. Replace with safer environment variable expansion using parameter expansion or `envsubst`.
```suggestion
      export AGENT_CONFIG_DIR="${toString cfg.dir}"
      AGENT_CONFIG_DIR="${AGENT_CONFIG_DIR/#\$HOME/$HOME}"
```

[^1]: CWE-78: OS Command Injection - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html

source_pr_title: Fix literal $HOME in AGENT_CONFIG_DIR + install claude CLI
author: amazon-q-developer
body:
:stop_sign: **Security Vulnerability**: Using `eval echo` on environment variables that could contain user input creates command injection risks[^1]. The `AGENT_CONFIG_DIR` variable originates from `cfg.dir` which is user-controllable. Use safer parameter expansion instead.
```suggestion
      _SKILLS_DIR="${AGENT_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.local/share/agent-config}/skills"
      _SKILLS_DIR="${_SKILLS_DIR/#\$HOME/$HOME}"
```

[^1]: CWE-78: OS Command Injection - https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html
